description: Land Title Settlement Department - Deldoowa, Kaluthara D/S Division, Kaluthara District - Cad Map No. 530149 (24/0827)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in the Kaluthara district. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
